summary: Frontend-only regression after the BACKEND image-proxy upgrade (AVIF-first negotiation for /api/files/...?fmt=auto, threaded encode, disk-cached variants, immutable Cache-Control). Re-verified across PUBLIC home (/), trip catalog landing (/viajes/surdemarruecos), itinerary detail (/viajes/atlas_desierto/programa_4n_5d), and ADMIN (/admin) — including the Live Preview iframe, the Galerías editor (GalleryManager main+rail), and the Biblioteca tab. After scrolling top-to-bottom to trigger lazy loads on every page, ZERO broken images (img.complete && naturalWidth===0) were observed anywhere. All proxied content imgs were emitted as /api/files/...?w=<width>&fmt=auto and decoded successfully. Carousels still navigate (clicked first next button on trip page successfully). No visual quality regression detected from AVIF/WebP delivery.
critical_code_review_comments: Image pipeline regression looks clean. All proxied tags via /api/files emit fmt=auto in src and srcset 320..1920; backend AVIF/WebP negotiation is transparent to the frontend.
On the trip itinerary, 58/238 imgs remained `pending` after a 20s top-to-bottom scroll — this is the expected lazy-loading behavior (well below the fold) and not a regression; none broken.
Pre-existing issues NOT re-tested (out of scope for this image-delivery change): cdn.tailwindcss.com prod warning, duplicate-key warning in LibraryManager (iteration_45).
